About Cyclonite Tech

Naval experience.
Practical expertise.

Specialist underwater expertise, grounded in experience and clear planning.

Our company

A specialist team,
built around experience.

Cyclonite Tech is a Malaysian business registered with SSM and based in Seri Manjung, Perak. Our five core crew and 11 contract divers are former Royal Malaysian Navy Clearance Divers with at least 10 years of experience.

Each diver is certified ADAS Part 3 and qualified in EOD, underwater welding and underwater demolition.
